hooks: She sells from her wagon: rope, lamp oil, salt, a spare lantern, and mule hire by the day. She haggles hard and keeps her word.
Her cart of salt vanished on the west road last week. She will pay 2 silver to whoever brings it back, and more for the name of who took it.
She says there were no orc tracks, only boots and a cart turned off the road into the pines.

concerns.text: Get her stolen salt back or be paid for it
